text:
Priya S: quick ask — can we add kernel-level attribution and kv-cache hit-rate to the per-route KPI card in Console? need p50/p95/p99 token latency split by: kernel, kv-cache, batch-queue, token-gen. also include throughput and error-rate per route.

Kai W: depends on ingest cost. token-level slices are high-cardinality — we should sample. are we ok with 1% sample for non-prod and full for high-traffic routes? :thinking_face:

Anna L: 1% sounds fine as default. two proposals: 1) server-side continuous sampling on the runtime that emits aggregated token-latency buckets per route+kernel every minute; 2) client-side sampling (lighter) with full traces only on flagged regressions.

Priya S: agree. server-side aggregation preferred so Console can show accurate pXX without exploding metrics. example aggregator output: `route=v1/chat, kernel=nvf32, bucket=0-8ms, count=1234, kv_hit=987`

Jordan M: for dashboard panels I'd use three rows: latency histogram (stacked by kernel+kv), p50/p95/p99 single-value spark cards, and throughput/error time-series. keep the histogram coarse at first (8ms buckets) to limit cardinality.

Priya S: here's a draft PromQL for p95 token latency from aggregated histograms (pseudo):
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(runtime_token_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, route, kernel))
```
This assumes we push `runtime_token_latency_bucket{route,kernel,le}` from the runtime aggregator.

Kai W: two cautions: 1) we need consistent `le` buckets across kernels; 2) kv-hit should be attached as a label or as a separate counter with same buckets to compute kv-hit ratio by bucket. otherwise attribution is messy.

Anna L: on kv-cache: push `runtime_kv_hit_total{route,kernel}` and `runtime_kv_request_total{route,kernel}` aggregated per minute. Console can compute rate(kv_hit)/rate(kv_request) as kv-hit-rate. also suggest adding `cache_warmth` gauge for prefix cache effectiveness.

Jordan M: alerts: recommend p95 > 150ms or error rate > 0.5% sustained 5m -> page eng-runtime. also create a regression alert when kernel attribution shifts >20% for p95 between rollouts.

Priya S: instrumentation action items:
- runtime: add agg exporter for token latency histogram + labels (route,kernel,kv_hit_label) at 1m cadence (Anna/Kai)
- metrics infra: ensure `le` buckets consistent & low-cardinality rollup endpoints (Jordan)
- Console: new per-route KPI card with: p50/p95/p99, throughput (rps), error-rate, kv-hit-rate, kernel-attribution waterfall (Priya/Jordan)

Kai W: for rollout, we'll enable on staging for 48h and run autosample validation with `perf-smoke` against a replay. watch ingestion QPS and Prometheus TS count.

MetricsBot: perf-profile: kernel nvf32 shows 12% p99 increase on route v1/chat when batching threshold set to 256 -> see link https://perf.internal/reports/1901234500 (span: runtime/batching) :rotating_light:

Anna L: good catch MetricsBot — that's a regression candidate. add to rollout checklist: when kernel config changes, run the p99 attribution diff job.

Priya S: closing loop — I'll open a small RFC with the schema for the aggregator and a Console mockup. tagging @Jordan M to start mock panels. thanks all :raised_hands:
